findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, so logs written through it can't be seen.
findings.body: `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` now logs via `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. With `TestLogger`, `FromContext` returns a brand-new `NewTestLogger()`, so the "Plugin Request Completed" entry goes to a throwaway logger. The `InfoLogs` of the `TestLogger` the test passed in stay empty. Any test that checks what the middleware (or other `FromContext` callers) logs will fail. A test that only checks that nothing was logged will pass even when the code is wrong. Return the receiver (`return f`) so calls are still recorded on the instance the test holds.
